Whole Lycanites successfed periodic admission budget plus nexttick HP rollback is not this same-invocation lastHurt bookkeeping; here neither elapsed quota nor HP rollback exists. Nominal accumulation is shared vocabulary, not additional credit.

Whole Ars attemptDamage publishes its own Pre/hurtbool/Post around one hit; it does not reconcile two native hurt attempts via a separate attachment observer or conditionally restore secondary entity-event presentation. Existing caution against treating Post as HP delta remains support0.

Whole existing Sunblock owns effectproducer, boss refusal versus ordinary reduction, synchronized persistent status shell/sound. Current Supernova is an actual attacking consumer with mixed-source perattempt reconciliation. Sunblock/Frozen policy, texture/sound layers, status registration and shared LivingData are explicitly0 extra.

Whole mana bubble owns Pre reduction payment and iframe-based repeated-cost suppression. Current helper rewrites lastHurt between source attempts then restores max(original, nominal admitted bookkeeping); no mana capacity/payment/refund policy and no duplicated source constants credit.

Whole EpicFight owns phase targetdedup, three-state hitbudget, temporary invulnerableTime reset and outcomequalified hitFX. Current helper has no phase targetset/budget and adjusts lastHurt rather than invulnerableTime; replay is specifically raw secondbool plus first bool-or-Post observation.
